wrong.why: Shemariah continues the sons-of-Harim list begun in verse 31, whereas the Hashum list begins in verse 33.
Vaniah and Meremoth are successive members of Bani's list, with no statement that Meremoth descends from Vaniah.
Shimei belongs to the sons-of-Bani list begun in verse 34, while bani-5 is another member listed alongside him.
Machnadebai continues the returned family of Bani's list begun in verse 34, which does not identify David's Gadite warrior.
Amariah and Joseph are successive members of Bani's list, with no statement that Joseph descends from Amariah.

missing.why: The Hebrew explicitly includes this Eliezer among the Levites.

note: Owner row 106680 looks misattributed: verse 18 places Maaseiah in Jeshua's family grouping, while Harim's separate list begins in verse 21; the row is preserved as instructed. The overlapping Jarib and Eliezer records cannot be distinguished conclusively from this chapter alone.
